usage: The word '叉燒包' is used to refer to a specific type of steamed bun filled with BBQ pork.
It functions as a noun in a sentence and can be the subject or object.
'叉燒包' can be counted, e.g. '三個叉燒包' means 'three BBQ pork buns'.
You can use it in questions when ordering food, like '有冇叉燒包？' meaning 'Do you have BBQ pork buns?'
It is commonly used when talking about dim sum or Cantonese snacks.
